purpose: Secondary dense-layout control for the K=1 Quadrants ESN benchmark
benchmark_scope: Authored scalar K=1 Quadrants row-parallel kernels on Metal; two dense layouts and CSR
layout_mechanism: At fixed source, adjacent receiver threads read adjacent f32 weights in source-major storage; receiver-major spacing is N*4 bytes. This is a locality hypothesis, without hardware-counter attribution.
changed_code: Only dense upload layout, dense weight indexing and input-integrity expected layout differ
aggregation: Median of three seed medians for elapsed time; median of three per-seed ratios of medians for ratios
protocol: Six recorded complete three-path permutations per clock/seed after two warmup blocks; every path occupies each position twice
relation_to_primary_receipt: Separate current-build confirmation; original 39-case/5-block measurements and headline values remain unchanged
background_condition: Interactive desktop; private before/after process/memory/power snapshots retained with execution reports. Close one-trial layout differences are descriptive.
reproduction: Run the existing ESN command for B=1/32 and seeds 7/19/41 to save frozen cases; run the retained run-case.py with corresponding --batch and --seed using the exact two demo snapshots and current build
numerical_checks: All three paths pass original float64 gates and byte-match saved qualified CSR; every actual warmup/timed output byte-matches the saved qualified result; input integrity checked before/after clocks
